conclusions: Exact principal, action, full command, grant/evidence revision and scope bind each operation; refreshed transport admission does not rewrite historical proof identity.
The paired control token is bound to actual backend PID and xid8 before redemption, with retirement after the main transaction releases its locks.
Current real research row, membership, exact read grant, role and consent remain independent prerequisites; unsupported and old source revisions deny.

The fixed final validation/retirement transaction rechecks the same selected lifecycle grant/evidence and current research authority. Its COMMIT is the last database revocation point; the host thereafter fences the captured absolute deadline.
Scope/control heads are digest-bound and current reconstruction denies rewound pointers with newer retained revisions. Explicit operation recovery remains historical under fresh inspect authority.
Consent deadline uses only already eligible alternatives, maximum coverage per required subject/path and minimum across required subjects/paths, bounded by all other admission deadlines.
Raw privileged mutation probes are scoped to the guarded disposable PostgreSQL journey and use pinned-client unconditional rollback.
limits: No actual PostgreSQL execution, hosted activation or provider action was performed in this review.
No atomic database authorization with later network delivery is claimed; absolute deadline enforcement assumes a trustworthy synchronized host clock.
Arbitrary privileged SQL logins can change deferred-constraint timing; the reviewed boundary is the fixed trusted host/repository transaction contract.

Default-off partial lifecycle controls do not implement requester decisions, tombstones, physical disposal, shared-key retirement, export, material inventory or administration after research withdrawal.
Full stale-database restore resistance and underlying legal authority are not established by fingerprints or synthetic fixtures.
